verdict.rationale: Pendo's Leo is documented as monitoring continuously and sending alerts in Pendo and Slack when something shifts, which covers the abnormal-metric alerting half of the story. Nothing in the pack shows dashboard subscriptions, and the alerting is described only in a single marketing line, with no detail on metric selection or anomaly thresholds. Missing for 10: dashboard subscription/scheduled delivery, configurable per-metric anomaly thresholds, in-depth docs on alert setup, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can subscribe to dashboards and get alerted when a key metric moves abnormally

citations.quote: Leo monitors continuously. Get alerts in Pendo and Slack when something shifts -without having to go looking for it.
